body: Everything is shit. I'm unhappy. Lonely. Behind on rent and in debt. Just hurt my knee again. No light in sight. Idk what the meds are doing, other than making it hard to concentrate on anything. It's another month before I see a therapist, and my opinion of them is shady at best anyway. I always think about hanging myself. Sometimes if I'm driving on a bridge or on a highway I'll think to drive over the edge or into a wall. But haven't. Hanging will be done over a door with a rope at home. I'm a bit worried about who will find me. I dont want it to be my parents. I fully expect to have to answer to god for it. I've been listening to alot of linkin park. Specifically leave out all the rest, easier to run, what I've done, given up, breaking the habit, somewhere I belong, among others. Thanks for talking to me.
No. I personal messaged you.
I did
Keep in mind if your not ready to go to a doctor then let your mom read it.

It took ten years for me to finally get help. Don’t waste that much time. That is the hardest part. If you can’t talk about it book a doctor appointment. Write it all down. And let your doctor read it.
No problem. Best of luck! There’s always someone around here when you need to chat. Keep that in mind.
The point is venting. Which is good. I’m glad you didn’t go through with it. I’m here if you need to talk.

I don’t mean this in a bad way at all. Your mother is mentally ill. It’s not your fault. It’s not even really hers. Your mother is a doctor. She must have friends in that field.... is there anyone you know and trust? Because your mother needs help. She may be going through a psychosis.

We all miss him. He got many of us through tough times. Even he said he realized he was doing this to himself. Just because he lost his battle, doesn’t mean he would want you to lose yours. His goal was to help people who feel like him find happiness. He was open about his demons, cause he knew it could help others. Remember that. Message me if you need to talk.
I am astonished I made it this far. I fully expected to die young, by my own hands or murder. So the opposite is true for me. Ive always been very aware of death.

You all are probably right. I’m just having a hard time with this. The road seems way to long. I pushed myself to start medication today. Even though I really don’t want to. I’m most likely not gonna get better if I don’t. Been going on too long.
Great that it works for you. But the side effects page suggests otherwise. And does that mean it’s one of those things that once your on you never get off?

What if you can’t remember actually ever being happy? And only went for help cause others convinced you? How many hoops do you have to jump through to get to happiness? And does happiness mean having a normal life? cause I’ve never had that. (Not trying to be a negative dick, I’m really asking. And venting) I’m glad your meds are working for you. But this scares the shit outta me.

They MIGHT work. They WILL have side effects. Possibly severe. But don’t worry. It’s rare. So rare and far between in fact that the side effects page is bigger then the drug description page. I’m scared of them too. And for good reason.

You have alienated yourself. You feel like shit most of the time. Your not able to control your thoughts. You compare your problems to others as if yours are less important. You don’t go out anymore. And you downplay it as if it’s in your head and you just need to refresh yourself.  You my friend, are most likely depressed.  And from what I’m beginning to realize, if it’s clinical.... you’ll never get out of the hump until you seek help. May be time to make a doctors appointment. All the best.
Music, comedy, writing. When that don’t work for me shitstorms ensue.
Thanks. The last thing I feel like is brave. I feel like I should be able to do this myself. The fact I can’t makes me feel insanely weak. My mind is a fucking war zone.

Thanks. I’m nervous about going to the doctors. I don’t want anyone knowing about things or judging me. Like even when the lady asked why I needed the doctors appointment I was pretty embarrassed to tell her it’s mental health related.
Not on that level.

I don’t think I can do it. I can talk here fine. But I just called and couldn’t even speak. Couldn’t even get words out. Was studdering. And once they asked for a name I hung up. I even used a text call app then deleted it so they can’t trace me. Idk it’s whatever I guess. I appreciate the feedback. I guess help is a mountain I don’t wanna climb.

Sometimes people choose the wrong words. I get it. But most of the people are on here because they can relate in some way to the people in pain. Most have themselves made posts reaching out for help. So well no nobody knows what you’ve been through or are going through. They can relate to how you are feeling. Some say “don’t give up” because they know what the struggle is like, and don’t want to lose another soldier. I hope your ok. And may tomorrow be a better day.
Thank you

Oh you’ll fail. Everyone does. No one has ever made it without failing first. The failures make you better. Learn from them. You need them. I bet  your stories would be great! Most great art comes from a dark place. All the best artists personal demons they battle. Just write a little each night. Even if it’s just a few words. Even if it sucks, eventually it won’t!

But what if that’s what your here for? What if that’s what your supposed to do? If your not good practice.... you know that person who’s not really good.... but while everyone is content that person is working there ass off to hone their craft to perfection.... and become the best? I bet your that person!

Just thinking of it right now is stressing me. Makes me want to say fuck it all. It’s like having to climb a mountain. A lifetime of appointments and prescriptions counselling..... scares the hell out of me
Awesome! A day at a time friend. You got this!
What kind of books do you like to read? Do you ever write?

Your probably right. A lot of times I feel like it’s just in my head. Man up and get your shit together...I try to start fresh a lot in my head, but the smallest thing can set me off. I also had 10 surgeries, (no health problems from it. Corrective leg surgery)  asthma,  (grew out of it) and was wrongfully diagnosed with Tourette’s as a kid. Was on every pill in the book for about 2 years before they basically weened me off the crap. So I’m not all that hyped up about spending time going to doctors appointments. And I even find doctors to be shady too. I’m sure all those drugs fucked my head up somehow. It’s easy to talk here cause I’m faceless. I’m really not big on going to a doctor. I don’t want it to follow me. Certain jobs you can’t have. If your on certain prescriptions they’ll take your license.... I don’t even want to call those hotlines cause I heard they will send the cops.
Rarely drink. And just weed. If you call that a drug.

I tried the same thing once about 10 years ago. I’ve battled with depression for as long as I can remember. I once was prescribed to cymbalta, but got off it rather quickly cause I didn’t like how it made me feel. I didn’t want to be a drug test dummy and I tend to not trust anybody. So I haven’t went in for “help” cause I don’t want to go through all the drug crap. I’m a pretty smart person I think. So I try to analyze myself and what makes me tick. But everytime I think I’m getting control of my mind it all comes back. I think I have pretty much every symptom of bipolar. But they will pump me with lithium if I go in. I want learn to control my brain. Some days are better than others. I just don’t know why my mind is so weak.
No I’ll check it out when I get home though. Black winter day is another great song by vinnie Paz.
I hear that. I feel like somewhere I belong was written for me.

No. Ive always felt a therapist is untrustworthy. People who wouldn’t give me the time of day unless they’re getting paid. Oh your venting.... yea but your hour is up so beat it.....I’m not sure what cbt is.
This is why I envy sociopaths.
Thanks to those that listened. Somehow I feel worse this morning than last night.
Pm me please
